verdict.rationale: The Snapdragon X2 Elite Extreme is a laptop processor, so running it headlessly or in CI is a category error. Headless operation and CI automation are properties of software products, not of a CPU/SoC. AI Hub's cloud-hosted device profiling is a separate ecosystem service with no evidence it covers this chip, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
